calibration_gate.C1_coverage: for both arms and every zone z: among calibration casts of workings whose quartet contains z, the share in which the candidate containing z is ranked first (a tie for first counts its share 1/k) lies in [0.18, 0.32]
calibration_gate.C2_type_I: 1000 simulated series with no signal: empirical rejection at alpha 0.05 <= 0.065 for P1 and for P2
calibration_gate.C3_curve: descriptive power at planted fractions 0.10, 0.20, 0.30, 0.45, 0.60 of workings; reported, not gated
calibration_gate.C3_on_channel_control: 200 simulated series in which one of the twelve canonical passages per working is replaced by a passage into a zone of the target pair: rejection >= 0.95 for P1 and for P2
calibration_gate.data: synthetic casts only, from registered seeds int(SHA-256('OUTSIDE-2:calibration:' + W + ':' + i)[:16], 16), i < 1000
calibration_gate.rule: W013 may not be admitted unless C1, C2 and C3 all pass. If any fails, the apparatus is not modified within this registration.

claims.on_failure: the registered claim that this canonical apparatus selects target-related information under these conditions is not supported
claims.permitted_on_success: register 1 (P1 and/or P2 departures) and register 2 (canonical-specific structure if P2); access, not agency or communication

evidence.arm_labels: recorded openly in the ledger: scoring is mechanical, so there is no judge to blind; querent feedback shows the readings unlabelled

frozen_mechanics.null: N1 degree-matched typed rewiring, fresh instance per working: n1_degree_matched(93000 + k) for working Wk

generation.cast: 32 physical coin tosses H/T; seed = int(SHA-256(working id + ':' + tosses)[:16], 16)
generation.querent: holds the fixed question during the physical cast
generation.question: what is the scene that will be shown at the close of this working?

protocol.operator_ruling: 6 October 2026: close OUTSIDE-1 v2.1 as the instrumentation is faulty; continue from W013 to W100 under the Numogram-as-reader design, with a target pool built only from what the reader can express, so that channel capacity is checked before any working.

predecessor.pooling: none; W007-W012 are never pooled with OUTSIDE-2

primary.P1: one-sided exact randomization test over the target draw: T1 = sum over workings of the canonical arm's mid-rank of the target; p1 = P(T1' <= T1)
primary.P2: one-sided exact randomization test over the target draw: T2 = sum over workings of (null mid-rank - canonical mid-rank) of the target; p2 = P(T2' >= T2)
primary.interpretation: P1 alone = departure from chance somewhere in the canonical apparatus; P2 = canonical-specific advantage over the same-cast null. The Numogram-specificity claim requires P2.

reader.kind: Numogram-as-reader; no language layer in evaluation
reader.ranking: candidates ranked by score, higher first; ties take mid-ranks
reader.reading: the ordered destination zones of the twelve recorded passages, per arm
reader.reference: REF_CASTS = 4000 reference casts per graph (canonical, and each working's null), seeds int(SHA-256('OUTSIDE-2:reference:' + graph tag + ':' + i)[:16], 16); frozen in outside2_reference.json before any working
reader.score: for candidate zone pair S: c = number of passages whose destination is in S; score = P(C < c) + 0.5 P(C = c) under the same arm's frozen reference distribution of C for S

target_pool.displayed_scene: the registered lexicon_v2 fragments of the candidate's two zones, in zone order; display only, no role in scoring; no demon names
target_pool.draw: target index = int(SHA-256(32 bytes OS entropy || ':target-draw'), big-endian) mod 4, only after the reading event is sealed
target_pool.expressibility: every candidate is a set of zones the reader emits; coverage is tested in C1
target_pool.quartet: for working W: zones 0-9 shuffled by random.Random(int(SHA-256('OUTSIDE-2:quartet:' + W)[:16], 16)); candidates are the disjoint pairs (z0,z1), (z2,z3), (z4,z5), (z6,z7)
